exact.技能按每方的设置（全 5 级或已绑定角色）；双方固定在交战距离上（可分两个阶段）: Skills follow each side's setting (all V or your bound character). Both fleets hold at the engagement range (optionally in two phases); target transversal = max speed × target motion; targets beyond lock range can't be locked. Modules with long reactivation delays (Assault Damage Control etc.) are not counted as active. With focus fire, every 15 ships share one target. Capacitor is simulated every second: when it runs short, cap-hungry weapons (lasers / hybrids), repairers, remote reps and EWAR run proportionally; each ECM cycle jams with probability jam strength ÷ target sensor strength. Overheating ignores heat damage; command bursts assume T2 bursts + max skills + command ship + mindlink (about 2.7× the base value). ISK uses the universe average price (hull + modules + ammo + drones). Fits lost in this fight: the most common fit this hull died with in this battle (the enemy's same hull if your side lost none) — fleets usually fly doctrine fits, so each hull uses one fit; recent common fit: the most common fit in its last 20 losses over 7 days. Results are indicative only.

Sell-side share: ESI only has a daily average price, so we solve "average = f × daily high + (1 − f) × daily low", volume-weighted over 30 days; "est." means it was approximated from current buy/sell prices and the 30-day average. Per day = smaller of buy-side and sell-side daily volume × share; profit per unit is after sales tax, broker fees on both orders and daily relist fees. This suggests what to trade, not what price to set.
